run_deepgemm_moe_permute: run deepgemm_moe_permute to scatter and permute MoE input tensors grouped by expert with quantization support
run_deepgemm_unpermute_and_reduce: run deepgemm_unpermute_and_reduce to gather and reduce grouped GEMM outputs back to token order for MoE
run_ep_scatter: run ep_scatter to scatter token data per expert using Triton kernel with atomic indexing and expert mapping
run_ep_gather: run ep_gather to gather and reduce per-expert token outputs back to original token order with weighted accumulation
test_compute_aligned_M: test compute_aligned_M to calculate aligned total token count for contiguous MoE layout with expert metadata
